Inclusion Criteria:
  -  ASA grade I- III
  -  BMI under 36 kg/m^2
  -  Scheduled surgery for primary total hip  [OR] or knee replacement
  -  Age 18+ years
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Contraindications  [OR] or failure of neuraxial anesthesia
  -  Patients must not be outpatient total hip  [OR] or knee procedure
  -  Known intercurrent UTI, [OR]  incontinence, [OR]  or urinary retention not addressed by pre-operative urologic consultation  [OR] and correction
  -  Pregnancy
  -  Current nicotine, alcohol  [OR] or drug abusers
  -  Pre-operative narcotic use (any narcotic consumption within 3 days prior to surgery)
  -  Post- operative parenteral narcotic administration
  -  Allergy  [OR] or intolerance to liposomal bupivacaine, [OR]  bupivacaine, [OR]  celecoxib, [OR]  dexamethasone  [OR] and/or pregabalin
